description: Code and state tables behind the manuscript 'A Second-Order Damage Tensor Is Sufficient for Damage-Induced Permeability; Scalar Crack Density Is Not'. Includes the solver (elasticity, AT2 phase field with crack-length control, FFT-Galerkin Darcy homogenization, damage tensor and aperture extraction), the analysis scripts, and the state tables for the two-dimensional sweep (210 states), the two-dimensional sweep with aperture (212 states) and the three-dimensional sweep at 96^3 (410 states). Every figure in the paper is regenerated from these tables by the included scripts.
